name: Manor Mistmantle
summary: In Duskwood's shadowed northeastern hills, Manor Mistmantle lies north of Darkshire. Once a family homestead, the estate has fallen into ruin, where ghouls prowl under the command of its infamous master.

sections.title: A Blighted Homestead
sections.body: West of Beggar's Haunt, Manor Mistmantle's ruined grounds are choked with decay. Vicious ghouls prowl there, guarding the broken house. In the untended garden, a solitary, sorrowful blossom called the Tear of Tilloa is the only sign of living beauty on the entire property.

sections.title: The Master of the Estate
sections.body: Stalvan Mistmantle, once a schoolteacher and private tutor, now acts as an agent of the undead. His horrific crimes against the family of his student became dark legend across the kingdom. He lurks on the upper floor of his family home, among remnants of his slaughtered victims, with shambling horrors guarding him. Travelers and investigators from Darkshire often find that the trail of Duskwood's most notorious phantom ends at this blood-soaked manor.

faq.answer: Manor Mistmantle lies in northeastern Duskwood, north of Darkshire and just west of Beggar's Haunt.
Stalvan Mistmantle belongs to the estate. The former tutor now exists as an undead creature, surrounded by ghouls.

faq.q: What is the Tear of Tilloa?
faq.answer: The Tear of Tilloa is a solitary, delicate flower blooming in Manor Mistmantle's garden. It is the only surviving sign of natural life amid the decayed grounds.

faq.q: Why are there undead guarding the grounds?
faq.answer: Ghouls roam the manor grounds as minions bound to Stalvan Mistmantle. They protect their master and slaughter trespassers on his blighted estate.

angles.text: As an Alliance investigator tracking the grim fate of Stalvan's victims, you reach Manor Mistmantle, the tragic final destination of the Legend of Stalvan.
